verified_facts.text: Park Hyatt Toronto is in Yorkville, central to Bloor Street and Avenue Road.
verified_facts.excerpt: Central to Bloor and Avenue Road, Park Hyatt Toronto puts you just steps away from world-renowned museums, art galleries and historic sites.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a short walk from the University of Toronto and Queen's Park.
verified_facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Toronto is perfectly situated in charming Yorkville, only a short walk from iconic landmarks like University of Toronto and Queen’s Park.

verified_facts.text: Writers Room Bar is a rooftop lounge on the 17th floor with views over Queen's Park and the city skyline.
verified_facts.excerpt: Writers Room Bar, our rooftop lounge with views overlooking Queens Park and the city skyline, cocktail in hand.

verified_facts.text: Writers Room Bar is on the 17th floor and celebrates the literary voices behind its 50-year story.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the 17th floor, Writers Room Bar reimagines the classic cocktail lounge, celebrating the literary voices behind its 50-year story.

verified_facts.text: Joni Restaurant is guided by Executive Chef Jonathan Williams and uses locally sourced, sustainable ingredients prepared in-house.
verified_facts.excerpt: guided by the vision of Executive Chef Jonathan Williams. Honouring the richness of our region, our dishes are crafted from locally sourced, sustainable ingredients

verified_facts.text: Joni offers a five-course dinner tasting menu with optional Ontario wine pairings.
verified_facts.excerpt: including a five-course dinner tasting menu with optional Ontario wine pairings

verified_facts.text: Afternoon tea at Writers Room includes house-made bites and loose-leaf Sloane Tea selections.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our afternoon tea includes house-made bites and loose-leaf Sloane Tea selections.

verified_facts.text: Stillwater Spa has treatment rooms, two couples' suites, and manicure and pedicure services.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stillwater Spa offers 11 treatment rooms, two couples’ suites and manicure and pedicure services.

verified_facts.text: Stillwater Spa has a sauna and steam room.
verified_facts.excerpt: the sauna and steam room feel like a true urban escape

verified_facts.text: The hotel stewards a permanent art collection inspired by the property's past.
verified_facts.excerpt: Park Hyatt Toronto proudly stewards a permanent art collection inspired and driven by the property's illustrious past and much-anticipated future.

verified_facts.text: The hotel reopened in 2021 after a four-year renovation that added a residential south tower.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Park Hyatt Toronto reopened in 2021 after an enormous four-year renovation including the addition of a residential south tower with Park Hyatt residences.

verified_facts.text: Rooms have Le Labo bath amenities and a Nespresso coffee maker.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nespresso coffee maker

verified_facts.text: Standard king rooms feature brushed walnut hardwood floors and a walk-in rain shower.
verified_facts.excerpt: Brushed walnut hardwood flooring compliments this 350-square-foot room featuring one king bed and city views. A walk-in rain shower and Le Labo products await

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a two-story bi-level penthouse suite with two bedrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: This two-story 1,430-square-foot penthouse suite boasts two bedrooms

verified_facts.text: The hotel is dog-friendly, and dogs get their own bed and water bowl on arrival.
verified_facts.excerpt: In the room, your pet will enjoy its own dog bed and water bowl on arrival.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers a complimentary house car service within a two-mile radius.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel offers a complimentary house car service within a two-mile radius

verified_facts.text: Overnight valet parking is charged and includes in/out privileges.
verified_facts.excerpt: Parking includes in/out privileges for overnight guests.

verified_facts.text: The nearest TTC subway station is Museum.
verified_facts.excerpt: TTC Station: Museum

verified_facts.text: Chanel, Holt Renfrew and the Royal Ontario Museum are within a stone's throw.
verified_facts.excerpt: Chanel, Holt Renfrew, and the Royal Ontario Museum are all within a stone’s throw.

verified_facts.text: Writers Room Bar is for guests 19 and older.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guests 19 and older can savour a setting where every sip opens a new chapter.
